preconditions.description: The input values n and k must satisfy the condition 2 <= k < n <= 1000.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of colors c must be at least 2.
The length of the edge coloring array must be equal to the number of edges in the graph.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= color <= c for color in edge_colors)
postconditions.description: All edge colors must be integers ranging from 1 to c.
